card.keepWhy: He walked away from what was wrong, and was welcomed in.
sources: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda (the sixth book): Ravana’s council urges war; his younger brother Vibhishana counsels him to return Sita; Ravana denounces him and he leaves Lanka

Yuddha Kanda: Vibhishana comes to Rama asking for refuge; Rama’s companions suspect a spy; Rama vows to protect anyone who comes to him even once seeking refuge, and says he would grant it even to Ravana himself
sharanam (refuge, shelter); sharanagati (taking refuge in God), central to Sri Vaishnava teaching
check: Verse numbers for Rama’s vow of refuge (often cited as Yuddha Kanda 18.33) and the “even if it were Ravana himself” lines; confirm.
In Valmiki, Vibhishana crosses the sea through the sky with four companions; the film says “crossed the ocean.” Confirm acceptable.

hook.say: before the story, can i ask you something? ever had to step away from people you love because they were going the wrong way? old friends, a group, a habit.
options: then you know what this costs. listen.
then this one is for you. listen.
good. keep this one for when you do.

steps.line: Ravana, the demon king, had kidnapped Sita. In his golden court, every advisor said: crush Rama’s army.

steps.q: Every advisor says: fight. Just one voice disagrees. Whose do you think?
steps.why: His own brother, Vibhishana. Listen to what he says.

steps.line: Except his younger brother, Vibhishana. “You were wrong,” he said. “Give her back.”

steps.q: Why was it so brave for Vibhishana to say “give her back”?
o: He wanted Ravana’s throne for himself
He spoke against his own brother, the king
Rama had promised him a reward
steps.why: He stood up to his family and his king at once. Doing right would cost him his home.

steps.line: Ravana called him a traitor, and threw him out.
So Vibhishana crossed the ocean to Rama’s camp, and asked for refuge.

steps.q: Rama’s army says it’s a trap. What do you think Rama does?
o: Keeps him under guard, to be safe
steps.why: He welcomes him. Most of the camp said no; Hanuman spoke up for him, and Rama said shelter is never refused.

steps.line: Rama’s army said it was a trap. But Rama said: anyone who comes to me even once asking for shelter, I protect.
steps.label: Yuddha Kanda

steps.pre: Rama went further: he would shelter anyone who asked, even
steps.why: Even Ravana, Valmiki has Rama say. Sharanagati, taking refuge, is still a beloved Hindu picture of how God receives anyone who turns to him.

steps.line: Vibhishana left everything behind for what was right. And he was welcomed into a whole new life.
steps.label: today

steps.q: Before a single battle, Rama does something for Vibhishana. What?
o: Makes him a general in his army
Crowns him the next king of Lanka
Sends him home to make peace
steps.why: Rama had Lakshmana anoint him king of Lanka with seawater, right there on the shore. Trust, given before it was proven.

say: here’s what i love. vibhishana lost his home for saying what was right. and he was welcomed into a whole new life.
hindus treasure rama’s promise: whoever comes for shelter, even once, is protected. the door is open to anyone who turns toward what’s right.

steps.q: There’s a Hindi saying that blames “the insider” for Lanka’s fall. Why do Hindus still honor Vibhishana?
o: He won the war for Rama single-handed
He was Rama’s friend from childhood
He chose what was right over family
steps.why: He told his brother the truth first, and left only when thrown out. Hindus count him among the seven chiranjivis, the long-lived ones.

today.say: is there a group or a habit pulling you the wrong way? take one small step away from it today, toward what’s right. many hindus lean on rama’s promise with a short line, “shri rama sharanam mama,” rama, you are my refuge. you can say it, or just hold the idea. it’s your choice.
options: one step. vibhishana’s crossing started with one too.
it is. it cost him a lot too. even a small step counts.
